title: Measured growth improvement
description: Diagnose actual funnel/retention evidence, design a bounded improvement, implement when requested, and verify outcomes.
intent: Complete the requested growth diagnosis, experiment plan, or scoped implementation using actual measurement. Do not infer ad spend, production experiments, outreach, or fabricated conversion/retention gains.

assignments.task: Define the outcome and metric/denominator, inspect approved funnel/cohort evidence, and identify uncertainty or absent data. Use product-analytics for compatible funnel/cohort definitions and product-instrumentation for event/identity QA when available; distinguish collection permission from export analysis.
Assess audience/channel/message fit and form supported improvement hypotheses.

assignments.when: Product behavior or onboarding contributes to the requested growth question.

assignments.task: Analyze actual supplied user evidence or propose a bounded study.

Design the relevant experiment/control/analysis plan and distinguish causal claims from observational evidence. Use product-experimentation when available, retaining assignment/exposure validity, guardrails and the planned stopping policy.
assignments.when: An experiment or causal interpretation is requested.

assignments.task: Assess interaction and accessibility friction against observed evidence.
assignments.when: The scope affects a user-facing flow.

assignments.task: Return scoped message variants grounded in approved claims.
Implement only requested scoped product/content/instrumentation changes and relevant checks; preserve existing user work.
assignments.when: The user requests source or content implementation.

assignments.task: Run only the explicitly authorized bounded experiment after prerequisites, recording actual conditions/results. Use product-experimentation when available, retaining assignment/exposure validity, guardrails and the planned stopping policy.
assignments.when: The user explicitly authorizes the specific experiment, environment, data, and execution scope.

assignments.task: Assess completed outputs/results and actual measurement if available; absent post-change data means no demonstrated growth gain. Use product-analytics for compatible funnel/cohort definitions and product-instrumentation for event/identity QA when available; distinguish collection permission from export analysis.
Check completed baseline/outcome claims, metric definitions, comparable conditions, and inference limitations.
Independently check changed behavior/instrumentation and actual regressions.

completion: The requested diagnosis, plan, or implementation is complete with actual baselines and evidence gaps.
Changes precede dependent execution/measurement, and growth gains are stated only with supporting observations.
Experiment, source-write, spend, and external-action boundaries follow the actual request.
